common_findings: N1,N3,J1,J2 prefer E012 by a modest margin; N2 records a tie, crediting F01’s fuller relational defense of claims administration. All5 medium confidence. Neither central conditional argument is shown false. E012’s paired cases more sharply isolate continued reparative assistance after accurate communication and payment; F01’s fair hearing/entitlement separation is sound, but its substantive residual-loss protection is less fully derived. Historical novelty remains unestablished for both.

remaining_issues.E012: Continuing defensive use is explicitly protected by a substantive undertaking; not every storage obligation has that scope. Actual likely helpfulness of destroyed evidence, proportionality, office-to-office cost allocation and immediate priority remain unsettled. Mere imaginable usefulness does not support every later expense.
remaining_issues.F01: Independent constraints on claims control support usable hearings more directly than funded protection against residual loss. Genuine competing interests, concentrated minority burdens and irrevocably lost hearing opportunities need further normative standards; no automatic refund follows.

coordinator_text_check: Reread E012§3 and§4–5. The two variants change the receiving procedure’s requirements while holding its mistake fixed. Photos could show a crack existed without proving contractor responsibility; in the alternative only an authenticated decision record can correct the flag. Do not describe the contrast as withholding proof of contractor guilt or simply changing photo contents. The five-year undertaking protects later challenges; neither predictable exact database error nor personal blame of a new administrator is required.
decision: Four preferences plus one tie support a modest E012 advantage, not automatic selection or rejection of F01. Preserve the neutral dissent.
